rules.CV-C1: claim concept: the tagged value, lowercased, runs of whitespace collapsed to one space, stripped; no mapping
rules.CV-G1: claim geography: the tagged value and its tag, casefolded and whitespace-collapsed for comparison
rules.CV-T1: claim time: every explicit four-digit year range `YYYY-YYYY`, `YYYY–YYYY` or `YYYY to YYYY` in an `explicit` temporal frame; several ranges are combined into their hull [min start, max end]
rules.CV-S1: claim scenario: an RCP pathway label `RCP<d.d>` in an `explicit` scenario value
rules.CV-D1: claim direction: the tagged value, lowercased and whitespace-collapsed, read only if it equals one of the direction words exactly
rules.PV-C1: prototype concept: the canonical ID for the record's `H.family_key` (fire_weather -> fwi_seasonal_value; heat_index -> heatindex_days_above_105F)
rules.PV-G1: prototype geography: `G.level` and the label built from `G.identifier` --- the `Crossmodel` id; `State, NAME`; or `State` --- with `G.provenance_status` carried
rules.PV-T1: prototype time: the four-digit year ranges stated in `T.per_role.baseline.value` and `T.per_role.future.value`; a role whose value states no range has no window
rules.PV-S1: prototype scenario: the RCP label in `C.per_role.future.value`
rules.U-1: `unknown` on either side -> not_evaluable, never incompatible
rules.C-1: concept: compatible only if the claim's normalized concept (or an approved mapping of it) is identical to the prototype's canonical ID under the same normalization; otherwise not_evaluable (no_approved_mapping). Never incompatible
rules.G-1: geography: compatible only if the claim's `explicit` geography equals the prototype label exactly, case-insensitively, at the prototype's level (`State`; `State, NAME`; cell id)
rules.G-2: geography: incompatible only if the claim's `explicit` geography names, as a whole word, a place on the committed `disjoint_from_united_states` list, and names no `not_disjoint` place and no US marker
rules.G-3: geography: otherwise not_evaluable --- different granularity, an inferred tag, a place not on the list, or a not-disjoint scope
rules.T-1: time: compatible if the claim's explicit year range overlaps the prototype's future window
rules.T-2: time: incompatible only if the claim is a `finding`, its explicit year range ends before 2045 (T2_CUTOFF_YEAR), and the prototype has a future window starting at or after 2045
rules.S-1: scenario: both sides an explicit RCP label: identical -> compatible, different -> incompatible; any other case not_evaluable. Reads the climate-scenario dimension only
rules.D-1: direction: evaluated only if concept is compatible; then both a direction word: equal -> compatible, different -> incompatible; otherwise not_evaluable
rules.C-2: concept (D-018, revised by D-019): when C-1 does not match, search the claim's tagged concept value with the frozen boundary-aware matcher (climrr.conceptmap.find_term, the M4-WP2 retrieval matcher) for the accepted surface terms of the prototype concept's family, `approved_lexical` entries of data/metadata/concept_map.yaml only. A hit -> compatible_at_family_level (not `compatible`: a family match is not metric equality), recording the family, the surface term, its [start, end) within the concept value and the entry's decision id. No hit for that family but a hit for another approved family -> not_evaluable. Lexical occurrence only; no synonymy

relation_rules.contradicting: concept positive (metric or family) and geography compatible, and direction is the only incompatible dimension
relation_rules.supporting: eligible; concept metric-compatible; scenario, time and direction all compatible
relation_rules.supporting_qualified: eligible; direction compatible or not_evaluable; family-level concept or scenario/time not_evaluable
relation_rules.related_insufficient: concept positive (metric or family), not eligible (geography not compatible), nothing incompatible
